You are a senior React developer, SEO expert and content strategist. Complete these 4 remaining tasks fully autonomously for the Lasarz Immobiliengutachter Osnabrück website.

## Task 1 - Fix All Image Assets
- Find every image placeholder in the entire project
- Find every broken image or missing image file
- For every missing image find a real free image from Unsplash using direct URLs like:
  https://images.unsplash.com/photo-XXXXXXX?w=800&q=80
- Use these specific Unsplash searches for relevant images:
  - Hero/main images: search 'modern house germany' 'real estate appraisal' 'property valuation'
  - Team photos: search 'professional businessman suit'
  - Service images: search 'house inspection' 'real estate document' 'property assessment'
  - Blog images: search 'german house' 'immobilien' 'property osnabrueck'
  - City pages: search 'osnabrueck germany' 'bielefeld germany' 'muenster germany'
- Replace every placeholder with real Unsplash image URL
- Add proper width height and loading=lazy to every image
- Add descriptive German alt text to every image
- Make sure all images are responsive with proper srcset if possible
- Test that all images load correctly

## Task 2 - Complete Content Optimization
Optimize content on every single page for maximum SEO:

HOMEPAGE:
- Make sure primary keyword Immobiliengutachter Osnabrück appears in first 100 words
- Add keyword naturally 3-5 times throughout page
- Add secondary keywords: Immobilienbewertung Osnabrück, Verkehrswertgutachten, Hausbewertung
- Improve all CTAs to be more compelling in German
- Add trust signals: years of experience, number of clients, certifications
- Add a statistics section: Gutachten erstellt, Jahre Erfahrung, Zufriedene Kunden

SERVICE PAGES - for each service page:
- Minimum 600 words unique German content
- Primary keyword in H1 and first paragraph
- Add benefits section with 5 key benefits
- Add process section explaining how it works step by step
- Add FAQ section with 5 questions specific to that service
- Add price range information
- Strong CTA at end

CITY PAGES - for each city page Bielefeld Flensburg Melle Münster Rheine:
- Minimum 500 words unique content per city
- Mention the city name naturally throughout
- Add local information about property market in that city
- Add specific services offered in that city
- Add local contact information
- Add map embed placeholder for that city

BLOG POSTS - for each blog post:
- Make sure minimum 1000 words
- Add table of contents at top linking to H2 sections
- Add key takeaways box at top
- Add FAQ section at bottom with 5 questions
- Improve keyword density naturally
- Add more internal links to relevant pages

## Task 3 - Complete Internal Linking Strategy
Build a complete internal linking web across the entire site:

HOMEPAGE should link to:
- Every service page
- Latest 3 blog posts
- All city pages
- Contact page
- FAQ page

EVERY SERVICE PAGE should link to:
- Related service pages
- Relevant blog posts about that service
- Contact page with specific CTA
- FAQ page
- City pages

EVERY BLOG POST should link to:
- At least 3 relevant service pages
- At least 2 other blog posts
- Contact page
- FAQ page
- Relevant city page if applicable

EVERY CITY PAGE should link to:
- All service pages
- Contact page
- Relevant blog posts
- Other nearby city pages

FAQ PAGE should link to:
- Every service page mentioned in answers
- Contact page
- Relevant blog posts

Create an internal linking component that shows related pages at bottom of every page.
Use keyword rich anchor texts in German like:
- Verkehrswertgutachten in Osnabrück erstellen lassen
- Immobilienbewertung bei Scheidung
- Professioneller Immobiliengutachter Osnabrück
Never use generic anchor texts like click here or mehr erfahren

## Task 4 - Complete Local SEO Implementation
Implement every possible local SEO signal:

LOCAL BUSINESS SCHEMA - Update with complete information:
- Full business name: Lasarz Immobiliengutachter
- Complete address in Osnabrück
- Phone: +49 (0) 541 - 600 99 220
- Email: info@lasarz.com
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00
- Service area: Osnabrück, Georgsmarienhütte, Bramsche, Melle, Bad Iburg, Belm, Bissendorf, Hasbergen, Hilter, Bielefeld, Flensburg, Münster, Rheine
- Price range: €€
- All certifications: BVS, DIAzert, REV, SV-R
- Payment methods accepted
- Languages: German, English

NAP CONSISTENCY - Make sure Name Address Phone is identical on:
- Homepage footer
- Contact page
- Every city page
- Impressum page
- Schema markup on every page

LOCAL CONTENT - Add to relevant pages:
- Mention Osnabrück landmarks and neighborhoods
- Reference local Gutachterausschuss Osnabrück
- Mention Bodenrichtwert Osnabrück
- Reference ImmoWertV and local market data
- Add content about Osnabrück property market trends
- Add content about surrounding areas property values

GOOGLE MAPS EMBED - Add to contact page:
- Create a map embed placeholder component
- Center on Osnabrück coordinates: 52.2799, 8.0472
- Add proper title and ARIA label in German

LOCAL KEYWORDS - Add naturally throughout site:
- Immobiliengutachter Osnabrück und Umgebung
- Sachverständiger Osnabrück
- Hausbewertung Osnabrück Kosten
- Grundstücksbewertung Niedersachsen
- Verkehrswertgutachten Osnabrück Finanzamt
- Immobilienwertermittlung Osnabrück

HREFLANG - Add if site has multiple languages:
- Add hreflang de for German pages
- Add hreflang en for English pages if they exist

LOCATION PAGES - Create if not existing:
- /immobiliengutachter-osnabrueck (main location page)
- /immobiliengutachter-georgsmarienuette
- /immobiliengutachter-bramsche
- /immobiliengutachter-bad-iburg
- /immobiliengutachter-belm
- /immobiliengutachter-bissendorf
Each with 500 words unique German content and full local SEO

## Task 5 - Final Build and Verify
- Run: npm run build
- Fix every build error found
- List all new pages created
- List all files modified
- Confirm all images load
- Confirm all internal links work

## Task 6 - Save Complete Report
Create docs/final-seo-complete.md with:
- Every task completed with details
- Every file created or modified
- Every image replaced with URL used
- Complete internal linking map
- All local SEO signals implemented
- Remaining items that truly need manual work like uploading actual brand photos
- Expected ranking improvements per keyword

## Rules
- Work completely autonomously
- Do not ask any questions
- Fix everything you find
- Write all content in professional natural German
- Never use placeholder text like Lorem Ipsum
- Always use real Unsplash image URLs not placeholders
- Make minimal changes to existing design
- Run npm run build after all changes to verify
- If something needs manual work like real API keys flag it clearly and move on

Start by scanning entire project to understand current state then work through all 4 tasks systematically
I'll help you complete these SEO tasks for the Lasarz Immobiliengutachter Osnabrück website. Let me start by examining the project structure to understand what we're working with.
